turns.text: So, what do you honestly think about the community college idea?
turns.zh: 那么，你老实说，对先去社区大学这个想法怎么看？

turns.text: Would you actually support that decision?
turns.zh: 你真的会支持这个决定吗？

turns.text: I think it sounds like an excellent first step.
turns.zh: 我觉得这听起来是个很好的第一步。

turns.text: We should definitely look into the application deadlines and course offerings.
turns.zh: 我们肯定得去查查申请截止日期和课程设置。

turns.text: Maybe you could even start in the spring semester.
turns.zh: 也许你甚至可以春季学期就开始。

turns.text: That would give me a few more months to save up some money and research different academic programs.
turns.zh: 那样我就能多几个月时间攒点钱，再研究研究不同的学术项目。

turns.text: I really appreciate you being so understanding about this whole complicated situation.
turns.zh: 我真的很感谢你对这整个复杂情况这么理解。

turns.text: Of course, you're my son and I want you to be genuinely happy and successful in whatever career path you eventually choose.
turns.zh: 当然啦，你是我儿子，我希望你无论最终选择什么职业道路，都能真正开心、成功。
